ns2:section.sectionText: Class will not meet on July 21st or 28th. Online & Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. Online scheduled class sessions require each student to have high speed internet access and either a headset with microphone or an external microphone and speakers so they may participate in the class discussions. Wireless internet is not recommended. Required text should be purchased before first class session: Koger, S.M. & Winter, D.D. (2010). The Psychology of Environmental Problems (3rd Edition). New York: Taylor & Francis.
